title: I create an mmo inspired from metin2
author: Willing-Being2101
selftext:
hello for almost 1 year i work at an 2d mmo inspired from metin2 directly in browser , i hope in few months  i will publish first beta test .  
You can play a quick prototype to see how my game feel :  
https://malxapp.itch.io/mythic2d  
please REVIEW my game and COMMENT on itch !   
thanks all for your attention can t wait to hear your opinnion .

comments.author: Lisarde13
comments.body:
The game isn't bad, but it didn't let me change the class when creating my character—it only allowed me to pick "Warrior." Also, the yellow starting font (and some others) is hard to read. On another note, using the Opera browser, the tab would switch whenever I double-right-clicked; I'm not sure if that's an issue on my end or with the game, but you might want to check it out.

I hope this constructive criticism helps. I couldn't play any further because of the issues I mentioned.

replies.author: Willing-Being2101
replies.body: i dont use only chrome but i will check , in prototype i have only warrior class , for people to explore maps inspired from metin2 , and to build his city , thanks for advice hope to see you in beta !

comments.body: Lol metin what a cancer to society :) ... jokes aside, the screenshot looks nice, good luck on the game :)

comments.author: Varrianda
comments.body: Couldn’t pick my class, you should start the player with combat. Selecting professions tools was extremely clunky and unintuitive. The world is very flat, player walkspeed feels very slow. I wasnt able to open the crsfting menu so i eventually stopped there. You should also add a shadow to the npcs/players

replies.author: Willing-Being2101
replies.body: uh thanks for advice , why you can t open craft menu ? you have place crafting table and move close to npc and press space ?   and the first "world" is your village where you can decorate by yourself , you can use teleportel to travel to others maps
